basic_profile.bio: I'm a senior at the University of Wisconsin-Madison, double majoring in Psychology and Spanish. I love discussing topics related to mental health and language learning. In my free time, I enjoy watching NBA games and caring for my parrotlet, Kiwi. I live in Madison, Wisconsin, and I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after classes or during weekends. I'm currently single and focused on completing my degree before entering the workforce.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in psychology and language studies, thanks to my academic pursuits at UW-Madison. I am also self-taught in understanding economic trends, particularly those related to the recent recession, by staying updated through various online resources and discussions.
